claims.claim: Discount if your ready to buy

risks.risk: Exact gearbox variant/model mismatch (seller says 'M272' but photos don’t confirm).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the gearbox identification label/stamped code on the casing (the exact part/variant number).
risks.if_unproven: Price as wrong/uncertain fitment risk (worst case: may not match and may require extra parts/return).

risks.risk: Not truly complete (missing required components for installation).
risks.proof: Full laid-out inventory photo of every included part + close-ups of all ports/connectors and mating surfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/needs parts (worst case: buyer must source missing items).

risks.risk: “Tested and working” not verifiable remotely (could fail after installation).
risks.proof: Short video of the gearbox being tested/engaged (or a written test report with date) plus photos of fluid condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven/assume overhaul risk (worst case: treat as needing rebuild).

risks.proof: Close-ups of casing seam/fasteners and sealant/paint marks around the perimeter to show factory condition.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown history (worst case: assume it has been opened/serviced).

risks.risk: Hidden shipping/handling damage (cracks, bent mounting ears).
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of all mounting ears, casing edges, and any visible cracks; include a straight-edge/angle shot if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged (worst case: parts replacement/repair).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the gearbox ID label/stamped part number that confirms the exact variant (the code that determines compatibility).
Send photos showing everything included to support “complete” (laid out parts + close-ups of connectors/ports).
Send a short video of the test (engagement/operation) or a written test note with date and what was tested.
Send close-ups of the casing seams/fasteners/sealant to support “never opened”.
Send compatibility proof: vehicle/engine details (or VIN/gearbox code) the unit came from.
response.reason: The seller’s reply asserts the claims, but without new photos or test evidence, the exact model/variant and completeness cannot be confirmed from the images. Without that, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set.
